description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'AccountingEnumerations' that provides methods to obtain enumeration options data related to accounting entities such as account types, account usages, journal entry types, portfolio product types, and accounting rule types within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: AccountingEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate EnumOptionData objects for various accounting-related enums.
